fields.headers: names for #include <...>: c from include/ and include/sys/, cpp from libc++ (include/c++/v1); since: the first -std setting a libc++ header has any content in (absent: all of them)
fields.functions: proto: the declaration as clang sees it in gnu11, attributes removed; every name is in share/wasm32-wasi/defined-symbols.txt
fields.macros: value: as the header defines it in gnu11 (left out when it is a compiler built-in); kind: constant or type
fields.modes: the -std settings an entry is declared in; absent means all of them
fields.std: since: the first -std setting that has the name (c++11 also covers older names)

licence.include/c++/v1 (libc++ 8): Each header says it is dual licensed under the MIT and the University of Illinois Open Source Licenses and points to libc++'s LICENSE.TXT, which is not in the sysroot. That file (upstream llvm-project release/8.x libcxx/LICENSE.TXT: Copyright (c) 2009-2019 by the contributors listed in CREDITS.TXT, under the University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License or the MIT License) is in this repository as licenses/libcxx-8-LICENSE.TXT, and libc++abi's (cxxabi.h, __cxxabi_config.h) as licenses/libcxxabi-8-LICENSE.TXT. public/clang/<pack>/LICENSE.llvm.txt is the LLVM project's top-level licence (Apache-2.0 with LLVM Exceptions, and the legacy University of Illinois/NCSA licence, Copyright (c) 2007-2019 University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign); it does not contain libc++'s MIT text.
licence.lib/clang/8.0.1/include (clang's own hea: Each file carries its own MIT-style permission notice and copyright line.
licence.include/ outside c++/v1 (the C library:: Unverified. The sysroot has no licence file for it and these headers carry no notice. Upstream wasi-libc's LICENSE today offers Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception, Apache-2.0 or MIT, with musl under MIT and cloudlibc under BSD-2-Clause; whether that covers this 2019 build was not checked.
licence.this file: Names, prototypes and constant values read from those headers, plus our own words. No comment text from the headers is copied.
